description: Main application source file for an Express-based backend API server. It sets up middleware, route definitions, health check, authentication, device management endpoints, and Swagger UI integration.

methods.name: Health endpoint
methods.description: GET /health - Health check endpoint returning system and configuration status.

methods.name: Login endpoint
methods.description: POST /auth/login - Authenticates user and returns JWTs.

methods.name: Token refresh endpoint
methods.description: POST /auth/refresh - Exchanges refresh token for new access token.

methods.name: Get current user profile
methods.description: GET /users/me - Fetches the profile of the authenticated user.

methods.name: Update current user profile
methods.description: PUT /users/me - Updates the profile (name) of the authenticated user.

methods.name: List devices
methods.description: GET /devices - Lists devices scoped to tenant with optional pagination.

methods.name: Create device
methods.description: POST /devices - Adds a new device under current tenant.

methods.name: Get device by ID
methods.description: GET /devices/:id - Fetches device details within tenant scope.

methods.name: Update device
methods.description: PUT /devices/:id - Updates device details within tenant.
